causes: Non-uniform film deposition (CVD/PVD)
Asymmetric pressure during chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP)
Thermal variation at the centre of the heater platen
Center.check: Check the central gas nozzles in the process chamber and the flatness of the CMP head.

causes: Ring-shaped thermal profile or excessive radial gradient on the heater platen
Turbulent gas flow at the edge of the central zone in the deposition reactor
Non-uniform slurry distribution in the CMP process
Donut.check: Inspect the concentric heating zones of the susceptor and the CMP slurry distribution system.

causes: Focus ring erosion in plasma etch
Insufficient helium backside cooling at the edge of the electrostatic chuck (ESC)
Edge-Ring.check: Inspect the focus ring in the etch chamber and the edge helium pressure.

causes: Aggressive mechanical contact on the wafer edge during transfer
Localised thermal stress at the clamping points
Edge-Loc.check: Check the aligner pins and the gripping force of the mechanical arm.

causes: Local defects on the photolithography mask (reticle contamination)
Particle adhesion during UV exposure or localised non-uniform deposition
Localised blockage of the post-etch rinse nozzles
Loc.check: Inspect the photolithography reticle and check the rinse nozzles in the process chamber.

causes: Widespread process failure (total vacuum loss or critical RF power variation)
Massive contamination of the chemical reactant supply line
Severe lithography calibration error across the whole wafer
Near-full.check: Stop the process tool immediately, check the plasma RF generator and the vacuum chamber integrity.

causes: Airborne particle contamination in the cleanroom
HEPA/ULPA filter failure above the workstation
Random.check: Measure particle concentration in the enclosure and check the laminar airflow.

causes: Scratching caused by the wafer-handling robot arm
Residual abrasive particles on the vacuum pads
Scratch.check: Inspect the robot arm path and clean the vacuum contact pads.

causes: Nominal operating parameters, no deviations detected
none.check: Release the lot to the next process step.
